dcterms:description: A corpus provided for the WASSA 2018 shared task containing around 188,000 tweets annotated with 6 emotion labels (anger, surprise, joy, sad, fear, disgust). The dataset has a balanced distribution of examples for the six label classes.
dcterms:title: WASSA 2018 Emotion Corpus

dcterms:creator: Cristian Danescu-Niculescu-Mizil
Lillian Lee
dcterms:description: The Cornell Movie Corpus, composed of around 300,000 utterances extracted from 600 movies, with a subset of 58,000 lines annotated for emotions.
dcterms:title: Cornell Movie Corpus
